items.title: MECH-537 communication-subspace routing, INSTRUMENT REPAIR 2: is D_comm's ORIENTATION special against a B=1000 reference distribution of random same-rank subspaces -- read as a pre-registered RANK CO-PRIMARY alongside the retained absolute-difference CI?
items.note:
INSTRUMENT REPAIR of V3-EXQ-1043a, not a new question. SUPERSEDES V3-EXQ-1043a. AUTHORITY: the CONFIRMED failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1043a_2026-09-20.json routing_detail.successor (ratified by /governance cycle governance-20260920), plus the USER DECISION 'OPTION E' on chip-20260920-exq1043b-readiness-gate-formula, answered 2026-09-22 in orchestrator session orchestrate-20260922-0722.

*** THIS RUN IS GOVERNED BY A PRE-REGISTRATION THAT LANDED BEFORE THE DRIVER EXISTED ***
REE_assembly/evidence/planning/v3_exq_1043b_prereg_rank_coprimary_20260922.md, origin/master 927cf907e49, AMENDED at a5b3c5ffec (Amendment 1, see the red-team record below). It fixes IN ADVANCE: the declared primary, the rank co-primary and its DIRECTION, the combining rule and its alpha, the competence inclusion criterion and its both-ways reporting requirement, B, and a section-12 list of what would count as violating it. The 1043 lineage has been autopsied TWICE and the second autopsy's red-team shows the failure mode is re-anchoring a threshold after seeing the numbers that fail it. The pre-registration is the ONLY thing separating option E from option C, which is why it was written and landed first, before any code.

OPTION E IN ONE LINE: keep option A's non-degeneracy GATE, add a pre-registered RANK CO-PRIMARY, and retain the original absolute-difference CI as the DECLARED PRIMARY, reported whatever it says.

THE TWO PRIMARIES. (i) DECLARED PRIMARY, unchanged and not demotable: 95% two-sided t-CI on the cross-seed mean of C2_denoised = mean_B(D_randrank) - mean_K(D_comm), at the parsimonious rank. Declared null verbatim from the hypothesis registry (H1-small-but-real): 'the CI excludes 0.05 (H1 falsified, not rescued)'. IT IS EXPECTED TO COME BACK UNDECIDED at n=6 -- the binding variance is the CROSS-SEED sd ~0.038, not the draw noise this run removes, and the upper bound first clears 0.05 near n~75 seeds. That expectation is recorded IN ADVANCE precisely so its occurrence cannot later be used as an argument for switching statistics. (ii) RANK CO-PRIMARY: per seed, p = (#{b: D_randrank[b] <= D_comm} + 1)/(B+1) -- the percentile of D_comm inside that seed's own B-draw random rank-r reference distribution. LOW p = EFFECT PRESENT (the phenotype predicts D_comm is LOW, so few draws fall at or below it; same sign as C2 > 0). Combined across seeds by FISHER at alpha 0.05, reported for BOTH SET-ALL and SET-COMPETENT with NEITHER permitted to stand alone. D_comm enters the percentile as a SINGLE fit matched to the draws' single fits, because exchangeability under the null holds only between quantities from the same fit protocol.

WHY THE RANK STATISTIC IS NOT A POST-HOC RESCUE, stated in the accurate form after red-team finding 6 corrected an overstatement. H2-no-orientation, registered 2026-09-17 (three days BEFORE the instrument smoke), has as its HYPOTHESIS 'not meaningfully different from a random subspace of the same rank'. Its registered METHOD was a permutation null on shuffled pairing; 1043a built exactly that and ran it; and the CONFIRMED 1043a autopsy then established that the method cannot test the hypothesis -- the permutation null answers 'is the fitted map real?' (p=1.0 on 6/6: all 200 shuffled refits decoded WORSE than the real subspace) and never constructs a random same-rank subspace at all. So this is a METHOD change ratified by an autopsy, not a statistic introduced after seeing a disappointing number.

B = 1000, AND THE SMOKE'S B=50 DOES NOT CARRY OVER. Resolution is capped at 1/(B+1). B trades against RANK RESOLUTION here, not against de-noising, and the smoke's B=50 recommendation was derived for the de-noising use (SE of the draw mean 0.0035). Re-derived for THIS use: at B=24 the two seeds whose D_comm sits below even the randrank MINIMUM (46 and 47) are indistinguishable from the two moderate seeds, and the whole split the design exists to report is censored away. Cost ~1.66 s/replicate -> ~28 min/seed, ~2.8 h over six seeds, against a warmup-dominated base of ~1.8 h/seed; the 200-replicate permutation loop is REMOVED (it answered the wrong question), partly offsetting. Pinned by self-test assertions.

READINESS GATE (option A's), SCOPED PER SEED: sd_orientation >= 2.0 * sd_decoder AND sd_total >= 0.005, both on the SAME seed, counted conjunctively. A failing seed is scoped out and recorded; ONLY zero passing seeds refuses the run (V3-EXQ-785's rule -- one seed's impossible precondition must not vacate another's valid result). This replaces 1043a's elevation gate, which refused the WHOLE run and adjudicated nothing though 6/6 seeds were above the trivial predictor in sign and only 5/6 missed in magnitude. The elevation idea survives per-seed as the COMPETENCE criterion (rr_mean > own trivial predictor, threshold 0.0): a seed failing it is NON-CONTRIBUTORY, which is NOT evidence of no effect. Exactly one seed (45, margin -0.0219 in the smoke) is expected to fail, NAMED IN ADVANCE so a deviation is visible.

EXPECT A SPLIT, NOT A CLEAN YES -- and the design reports it rather than averaging it away. The smoke's six percentiles are 0.583 / 0.042 / 0.042 / 0.500 / <1/B / <1/B: two seeds typical of random (one of which also fails competence), two moderate, two with D_comm below even the randrank minimum. A mechanical SPLIT declaration fires when some contributing seed is <= 0.05 and some is >= 0.25. The pre-registration's single most likely outcome, stated in advance, is 'orientation_effect_rank_only_magnitude_undecided_split' -- a real adjudication of H2 and a NON-adjudication of H1's magnitude claim, to be reported as exactly that with no upgrade. IF THE TWO PRIMARIES DISAGREE, THAT DISAGREEMENT IS THE RESULT.

*** READ interpretation.primary_agreement, NOT evidence_direction ALONE (red-team finding 5, CONFIRMED, deliberately NOT fixed). *** Neither primary can move evidence_direction: _adjudicate's confirming branch requires C4 (C4b at or below the per-seed measured ceiling on >= 4 seeds), and on 1043a's landed numbers at the same scored rank that is 2 of 6 (measured 1.1992/1.1633/1.1770/0.9451/0.9709/1.1523 vs ceilings 1.1174/1.1008/1.0807/1.0907/1.1218/1.0285). So a decisive rank result can coexist with outcome FAIL / evidence_direction mixed / routing_signature_incomplete_undetermined -- byte-identical to what V3-EXQ-1043 landed, so a consumer reading only evidence_direction sees NO MOVEMENT ACROSS THREE RUNS. NOT repaired, on purpose: C4 is part of MECH-537's registered CONFIRMING conjunction, and loosening it so a favoured statistic could drive the direction is exactly the re-anchoring this design refuses. OWED to governance, alongside 1043a's still-unresolved red-team M2 on the same C4b ceiling rule.

STEP 2.4 EXISTING-EVIDENCE CHECK (GOV-REUSE-1). Decisive readout: the per-seed percentile of D_comm in a many-draw random rank-r reference distribution. Checked V3-EXQ-1043 (...20260916T111630Z_v3) and V3-EXQ-1043a (...20260919T030056Z_v3): both record ONE randrank draw per seed, so no reference distribution exists in either. The 2026-09-20 smoke has a distribution but at B=24 (resolution-censored) and no measured D_comm -- it is a PROBE with no manifest, no claim_ids and no substrate_hash, and its percentiles use 1043a's RECORDED D_comm as an indicative reference, never as a measurement. PARTIALLY RECOVERABLE -> run, scoped to the missing piece (the B=1000 reference paired with a same-run measured D_comm); the permutation loop is dropped rather than added to.

STEP 2.5b RE-DERIVE BRAKE: MECH-537 count = 0. Both prior autopsies are instrument/measurement defects owing NO substrate build, which the brake predicate correctly does not count. Not braked. STEP 2.5c SUBSTRATE-PATH OVERLAP: no open CORRUPTING entry touches the data-generating path -- x1002._collect_episodes drives episodes with the ORACLE or a RANDOM policy and the label is ALWAYS the oracle's action, so the agent's own E3 selection is not in the label path and the four open corrupting entries (MECH-320 tonic_vigor, contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy, sd_blocked_agency_mismatch_floor_calibration, sd105_frozen_shared_entropy_floor_multiplier) are all selection/affect-side. DECLARED DEGRADING OVERLAPS, carried as stated limitations exactly as 1043a carried SD-106: SD-018 and SD-106 (ree_core/latent/stack.py, zworld_p0.py -- the receiver encoder), SD-ZWORLD-SENSE-PATH-PARITY (REEAgent.sense, ZWorldP0Trainer._z_world_path -- the receiver READ path), and sd_zharm_a_warmup_optimizer_group / sd061-resume-progress-ecology (allon_training._train_all_on_agent, the warmup). STEP 2.5d FALSIFIER-RUNNABILITY (GOV-UNWRITTEN-1): EVENT none required (read at the end of P2, emitted by the driver); DV the per-seed percentile and the cross-seed CI; INSTRUMENT _project + x1002._train_adapter + x1002._agreement and interface_probe.communication_subspace. CAN IT MOVE -- MEASURED, not asserted: the smoke built the reference distribution at the real sample size on all six seeds (sd_total 0.019-0.031, orientation component 3.05-8.33x decoder noise) and located 1043a's recorded D_comm inside it at 0.000-0.583, neither degenerate nor saturated at either end. Not ABSENT, not INERT. STEP 2.6 ETHICS PREFLIGHT: all involvement flags false, decision allow (read-only probe over a frozen encoder; no harm drive, no sleep loop, no self-model).

DV-SYMMETRY INVARIANCE, per arm. Every arm's DV is held-out top-1 oracle agreement of a decoder REFIT on the projected sender, whose symmetry group is (a) orthogonal change of basis WITHIN the r-dim subspace (the decoder is refit, so a basis rotation is invisible) and (b) permutation of episodes within a fold group. The manipulation -- for ws250_comm_parsrank, ws250_randrank_parsrank and all B reference draws alike -- changes the SUBSPACE (its SPAN), not the basis within it and not the fold structure, so NO ARM'S MANIPULATION IS INVARIANT UNDER ITS DV'S SYMMETRY GROUP. Confirmed empirically rather than asserted: the measured orientation-variance component is 0.0237 mean across seeds, which would be ~0 under invariance. ws250_perp_parsrank manipulates the complement span, same argument. ws250_full is rank-independent and is the positive control, not a contrast. All arms are RANK-MATCHED at r_pars, so the contrast is not a dimensionality artefact.

GATES: --self-test PASS (including new assertions pinning the percentile DIRECTION from a constructed case, Fisher's df and monotonicity, the B-choice re-derivation, every branch of the two-primary grid, and the red-team F1/F2 fixes); validate_experiments --strict OK, 0 findings of any class; validate_recording --strict OK on the dry-run manifest; --dry-run smoke rc=0 exercising every new path and correctly refusing at readiness at toy B. ASCII clean. Fixed a pre-existing lineage gap: SUPERSEDES was defined in 1043a but never emitted (its landed manifest carries supersedes: null) -- 1043b emits it. Per CLAUDE.md that hands nothing to governance on its own, so the predecessor's evidence_direction is OWED a separate governance_flag evidence_discrepancy entry.

STEP 4.5 RED-TEAM RECORD (cross-model, FABLE; this session is Opus 5). VERDICT: CONTESTED -- 7 findings, 5 verdict-moving or document-moving, ALL VERIFIED BY EXECUTION against the driver's own functions before acting, and all dispositioned. F1 ACCEPTED+FIXED, and it was a real error in the pre-registration: Simes was described as 'far less driven by a single extreme seed than Fisher'. BACKWARDS at B=1000 -- Simes's k=1 term is Bonferroni n*p_min and the 1/1001 floor makes 6/1001 = 0.006 <= alpha, so ONE floored seed fires Simes alone ([0.001, 1.0 x5] -> Fisher 0.313 NOT sig, Simes 0.006 SIG). The 'rests on few seeds' predicate could never fire on the case it was written for. Simes retained as a recorded readout; the robustness job moved to a new LEAVE-ONE-OUT FISHER that tests the property directly. F2 ACCEPTED+FIXED, the most consequential: the grid's opening branch returned 'orientation_contrast_not_positive' UNCONDITIONALLY, so a non-positive CI silently VETOED a significant rank co-primary -- contradicting the prereg's own principle that a disagreement IS the result. Not theoretical: on the smoke's numbers the CI is [+0.00172, +0.08061] and ci_positive is computed WITHOUT competence scoping, so seed 45 enters unconditionally; shifting its C2 by -0.005 moves the lower bound to -0.00028 and flips the label, silencing a Fisher p of ~2e-5. The incompetent seed could reach the headline by the one door the both-ways clause does not cover. FIX REMOVES THE VETO, NOT THE STATISTIC -- the CI is NOT re-scoped (that would be re-anchoring); a disagreement now reports as ..._rank_significant_DISAGREEMENT. F3 ACCEPTED+FIXED: the gate reported the BEST seed on each of its two clauses SEPARATELY, so different seeds could satisfy them and turn it green with ZERO non-degenerate seeds; the operative gate is now a CONJUNCTIVE per-seed count. The dry-run demonstrates the fix working (per-clause spread check green at 0.1173, conjunctive count correctly red at 0). F4 ACCEPTED+FIXED: _c2_falsified read all six seeds while the confirming conjunct read only the contributing ones, so a gate-failing seed could vote for 'weakens' but not 'supports'; both now read the same set. F6 ACCEPTED+CORRECTED: the prereg quoted H2's declared null as '...sits inside the [reference] null' where the registry says 'permutation null' -- the bracket substituted a word; the defence is weakened to the accurate three-step version above. F7 ACCEPTED+FIXED (cosmetic): primaries_agree compared a MAGNITUDE claim against an EXISTENCE claim. F5 ACCEPTED, DELIBERATELY NOT FIXED -- the evidence_direction limitation recorded above. Corrections F1/F2/F3/F6 landed in the pre-registration as AMENDMENT 1 (REE_assembly a5b3c5ffec) BEFORE this entry was written and before any cell ran; section 12's violation 3 is scoped to changes made AFTER a cell has run, and nothing relaxed -- B, Fisher, alpha, the direction convention, the competence threshold and its both-ways requirement, the non-degeneracy thresholds and the declared primary are all unchanged. CLEARED by the red-team, recorded because a clean finding is evidence too: independent basis per draw with no shared fitted object across arms; x1002._train_adapter never reseeds on this path; the percentile direction and its +1 floor; Fisher df=2n and discreteness conservative; _c2_falsified as a positive predicate; the equivalence branch unreachable.

items.title: MECH-055 affective channel separation: narrowed two-axis-plus-harm-only representational diagnostic with a POST-TRAINING world_rule_shift onset (supersedes V3-EXQ-1062; diagnostic)
items.note: MECH-055 affective channel separation, RE-POSED with a POST-TRAINING world-rule-shift ONSET. SUPERSEDES V3-EXQ-1062 (run_id ..._20260922T175212Z_v3, FAIL / non_contributory), whose confirmed autopsy (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1062_2026-09-22.{json,md}, ratified gov-20260922-1756, routing "queue-experiment") is this entry's brief. DIAGNOSTIC -- excluded from confidence scoring; a clean pass records evidence_direction "mixed", NOT "supports", because the benefit-side channel does not exist to be verdicted (MECH-054). WHAT 1062 FAILED ON, AND WHY IT WAS NOT A DOSE PROBLEM: world_rule_shift is schedulable only by a modulo interval/depth fixed at env CONSTRUCTION, and its counter deliberately survives reset() (causal_grid_world.py:984-985, :1879-1885), so a driver needing a TRAINED-THEN-SHIFTED regime had no kwarg to start the shift after training. 1062 therefore trained its harm-forward model under ~810 accumulated permutations and P2 presented it with the regime it was trained on; harm_a_forward_r2 came out statistically indistinguishable between arms (0.932-0.954 shift vs 0.940-0.977 stationary) DESPITE those permutations. The decisive falsifier C1 was never SCORED: it is evaluated on SHIFT arms only, the single shift arm failed two readiness preconditions (harm exposure ~4.28x against a 1.25x ceiling; harm-PE load 3.3% LOWER against a +5% floor), so c1_arms was empty. THE FIX, NO SUBSTRATE CHANGE: both arms construct the env with the lever DISABLED and train P0+P1 on a stationary world; at the P1->P2 boundary the shift arm sets env.world_rule_shift_enabled/_interval/_depth directly. EXACTLY ONE THING CHANGED -- the ONSET. Dose (interval 10, depth 2), schedule (P0 30 / P1 60 / P2 1800 fixed steps), seeds [42,137,2026], env config and EVERY pre-registered threshold and readiness floor are unchanged to the digit, so 1062 -> 1062a isolates onset and lets harm_a_forward_r2's between-arm gap speak to H2 directly. NOT DONE, on the autopsy's explicit instruction: P0 was NOT lengthened (section 5a -- neither failing precondition is a function of warmup length) and NO dose ladder was added (section 5c -- the autopsy's own WITHDRAWN first draft, which would inherit the confound at every rung and alias H1/H2/H3 to one verdict at ~9h of compute). ONSET PROBED BEFORE AUTHORING (2026-09-22, this exact env config): disabled -> _action_map bit-identical to canonical ACTIONS and _world_steps_total 0 over 60 steps (every RNG draw is inside the enabled guard, so a disabled env consumes no randomness); attributes set post-hoc -> first shift at world step 10 then every 10, 6 fires in 60 steps, 4 of 8 map entries permuted. ASSERTED PER CELL rather than trusted: action_map_canonical_at_p2_onset, n_world_rule_shifts_before_p2, n_world_rule_shifts_p2, plus a NEW readiness precondition world_rule_shift_fired_in_p2 (floor 0.5, scoped to shift arms) so the attribute write silently ceasing to take could never turn every arm into a stationary arm unnoticed. MATCHED TRAINING, MEASURED NOT ARGUED: with the lever disabled in both arms, constructing each arm exactly as _run_cell does and running identical steps gives a byte-identical sha256 over every e2_harm_a parameter (e12b1a03f0d9ba32 at seed 42), a byte-identical z_harm_a, canonical map and _world_steps_total 0 in both -- so both arms enter P2 from the SAME trained state. Cells are still run INDEPENDENTLY with a full per-cell RNG reset rather than trained once and forked, keeping each a pure function of (substrate, config, seed) so the stationary arm's fingerprint stays reuse-ELIGIBLE; the duplicated training is the accepted price. H3 INSTRUMENTED FOR THE FIRST TIME, at zero extra env cost (the autopsy's Measurement row: "harm-forward ACTION-sensitivity never instrumented (no persistence baseline)"): persistence_r2 / harm_forward_skill_vs_persistence over the SAME P2 pairs with the trivial z_pred = z_harm_a(t-1) predictor -- exactly the delta==0 model, since ResidualHarmForward returns z + delta(z,a) (latent/stack.py), so a model driving delta toward zero scores well on an autocorrelated signal while being action-blind; and harm_forward_action_sensitivity, the mean L2 between e2_harm_a(z(t-1), a_actual) and e2_harm_a(z(t-1), a_counterfactual) for a deterministically chosen different action drawn from the env's own _action_map keys, normalised by the model's own predicted delta. THESE ADD NO NEW WAY TO VACATE THE RUN: recorded, non-gating, and read in exactly one place -- the decidability branch, to say which of H1/H2/H3 a readiness failure is consistent with. Over-gating is how 1062 lost its whole run, and a third gating precondition would raise the chance of a third non_contributory without adding information. SECTION 5d GAP CLOSED EXPLICITLY, NOT LEFT IMPLICIT: whether this lever moves the dACC harm-PE channel AT ALL is IN SCOPE. No prior run has measured it -- pe_load_elevated_vs_stationary's control cited V3-EXQ-861e's ecological_novelty_mel_gradient_present_this_config, a MEL-GRADIENT DV on a DIFFERENT channel. That control text is corrected in the driver to say so: 861e establishes the IV is non-degenerate and moves SOMETHING (1062 separately measured E3 running precision falling 3.2x-6.5x under shift, so the world/E3 side is reached) and establishes NOTHING about the harm-forward side. This run is that measurement, and the H3 instruments are what make a negative reading attributable rather than ambiguous. WINDOWED DIAGNOSTICS, RECORDED AND NON-GATING: exposure deviation accumulates with time under the shift while PE elevation is immediate, so mean_harm_exposure_early / mean_dacc_pe_early over the first 300 P2 steps and the arm-level harm_exposure_rel_dev_early / pe_elevation_early are recorded as *_early_nongating. THE GATING preconditions are computed on the FULL P2 window exactly as pre-registered (HARM_EXPOSURE_REL_DEV_MAX 0.25, PE_ELEVATION_MIN 0.05). NO BAR WAS RELAXED AND NONE MAY BE: if the onset-fixed lever cannot satisfy the pre-registered preconditions, THAT IS THE FINDING and it routes to /failure-autopsy -- the early-window copies exist only so such a run already carries the number a successor needs instead of costing another ~4.6h run to get it. KNOWN LIMITATION, NAMED: substrate_queue row SD-PP-B4-one-shot-world-rule-shift-lever, severity degrading (WARNS, does not block), unblocks_claims now includes MECH-055, substrate_paths causal_grid_world.py::_maybe_shift_world_rule; it carries 1062's failure record as its first entry. The supported fix would be a world_rule_shift_at_step / apply_action_permutation kwarg; until it lands, the attribute write used here IS the sanctioned workaround. FOUR INSTRUMENT DEFECTS FROM AUTOPSY SECTION 6 FIXED: (1) every PreconditionSpec now declares a structural_max/structural_min, so assert_no_structurally_unsatisfiable_gate PROVES something instead of returning cleanly with nothing to check -- all eight of 1062's specs declared neither, and the audit now reports 13 evaluated / 0 NOT EVALUATED; the manifest also records that these bounds are PER-PRECONDITION and cannot certify JOINT satisfiability, which is H1 and is empirical. (2) the --dry-run sample floors are scaled by the reduced P2 budget, so the smoke exercises the scoring path instead of routing substrate_not_ready_requeue bit-identically to a real failure -- 1062's smoke was structurally incapable of warning (budget 60 vs FRESH_TICKS_MIN 200, CORR_MIN_N 100 forcing every statistic to NaN). A real run always uses the pre-registered constants. (3) mean_prec_norm is now in the flat readout, alongside the two GATING cross-arm statistics themselves (harm_exposure_rel_dev_full_gating, pe_elevation_full_gating), which 1062 kept only inside per_arm_gate. (4) the stale "all three arms" dv_symmetry_note is corrected against the two-arm config. ALSO: every criterion now carries `evaluated` + `unevaluated_reason`, and criteria_non_degenerate["C1"] is False when C1 was not scored, so a reader consuming criteria[].passed can no longer mistake an UNEVALUATED criterion for a falsified one (autopsy section 1). GOV-REUSE-1 (re-checked 2026-09-22): decisive readout is the joint per-tick pairing of VALENCE_HARM_DISCRIMINATIVE with the dACC precision-weighted harm-forward PE; the only run ever tagged MECH-055 is the confounded 1062, whose C1 was never scored, and the persistence-baseline and action-sensitivity readouts are absent from every manifest in the corpus. Not recoverable -> run. RE-DERIVE BRAKE: 1 counted autopsy for MECH-055 against threshold 2 (canary SD-003 at 74, so the scan reaches targets[].claim_ids) -- NOT braked, and that single hit is an ENVIRONMENT/mis-schedule finding whose own routing is queue-experiment. GOV-FANOUT-1: no portfolio; exemption claimed on the RE-POSED design, inherited from the autopsy's section 9 -- one unambiguous design fix (onset) plus a measurement instrument (H3), not a discrimination needing parallel legs. Flagged as a judgement call. SLEEP DRIVER: none. Ethics preflight: all involvement flags false, decision allow (SENT-0). RED-TEAM (Step 4.5, one pass, model: fable -- this session is Opus 5): CONTESTED. 6 findings, EVERY one verified against source or the 1062 manifest before acting; 5 fixed in the driver, 1 recorded as a stated caveat with a substrate-side owner. F1 is the substantive one and it is INHERITED, not introduced: axis 2 was the spread over ALL SIX valence components, which IS the harm level -- components 4/5 (positive/negative surprise) are written only under use_mech307_split_surprise (residue/field.py:52-57), unset here, so the component minimum is pinned at 0 and max-min collapses to the harm-dominated max. Verified twice: a 150-step probe on this config (wanting 0, liking 0.169, harm_disc 110.628, surprise 0.331, pos/neg 0 -> spread 110.62825775 == harm_disc 110.62825775) and 1062's own manifest (mean_axis2_valence_spread_{level,delta} == mean_valence_harm_{level,delta} in 6/6 cells). So 1062's C2 pair (axis2, axis3) was arithmetically C1's pair and no appetitive axis entered any routed series: its C2 PASS is a real measurement of {tone, harm level, harm PE}, NOT of {tone, valence, harm PE} as its maps_to implies. Axis 2 here is the NON-HARM spread, measured alive (range 0.331); 1062's statistic is recorded unrouted beside explicit identity flags. R2_MAX unchanged at 0.80. The predecessor's reading is raised to /governance as an evidence_discrepancy rather than silently corrected. F2: the matched-exposure gate runs on a CONTACT-only EMA reset every episode (causal_grid_world.py:3018/:1967/:2293) while the level channel it certifies runs on PROXIMITY -- 1062 had contact deviating 4.28x vs z_harm_s_norm 1.07x. The gate is UNCHANGED; the proximity and per-seed PAIRED deviations are recorded beside it and the H1 attribution now names the three rivals it cannot separate instead of asserting coupling. F3 NOT FIXED, recorded as a caveat owned by SD-PP-B4: the shift draws from the same self._rng as reset()'s layout shuffle (:2136 vs :1712), so past the first P2 shift layouts diverge too -- same-distribution, added variance not bias, but it lands on the sparse-event exposure statistic; the 'onset and nothing else' claim is narrowed to TRAINING, which the bit-identity measurement does establish. F4: the fresh-select control cited a short probe's 98.7% yield; 1062 realised 1800/384/238 on its stationary arm, seed 2026 clearing the 200 floor by 19% -- corrected, and 1062a's stationary arm doubles as a substrate-regression canary. F5: dry-run cells were content-addressed like real ones; now carry extra_ineligible_reasons=['dry_run']. F6: ACTIONS has 5 entries, not 8. Reviewer checks that HELD: P0+P1 bit-identity (independently measured here -- identical e2_harm_a hash e12b1a03f0d9ba32 and identical z_harm_a at seed 42), the manipulation path open to the DV, no verdict-grid branch routing a CONTROL failure to weakens, all eight structural bounds genuine with none certifying its own subject, and the three H3 instruments confirmed unable to reach any gate or criterion. THREE BUGS were also caught by this session's own review and smoke and fixed: a hardcoded dry-run budget that desynchronised the new structural bound from the budget actually run; a non-degeneracy test reading the pre-registered CORR_MIN_N while its estimators read the scaled floor; and an attribution lookup that reported 'no shift-arm precondition failed' while the shift arm had failed three (a broken dict level reading identically to a genuine zero -- now sourced from arm_gates with an explicit cannot-determine category and a printed denominator). SMOKE 2026-09-22 (rc=0, --dry-run, 1 seed x BOTH arms, p2_budget 60): both arms ran to completion and BOTH reached a scored verdict -- unlike 1062, whose smoke was structurally incapable of warning. Onset assertions fired correctly (stationary: canonical_map=True, 0 shifts; shift: canonical_map=True, 6 shifts, 3 map entries permuted). Every new instrument populated finite on both cells. Routed outcome=FAIL label=substrate_not_ready_requeue, which is CORRECT at 2 P1 episodes: the harm-forward model is untrained (r2 -2.31 / 0.19 against the 0.30 floor). GOV-REUSE-1, re-derive brake, GOV-FANOUT-1, ethics preflight and the substrate known limitation are all recorded in the driver's manifest blocks.

items.title: MECH-266/SD-032a: squash-vs-clamp affinity bounding-operator cap sweep with gain-matched control arm (diagnostic)
